sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. The leaders then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October at 15:00. Despite the recent defeat, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and have won seven of their last five matches overall.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) make their first ever trip to Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October, looking to continue their title push. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth entertain Eccleshall on the same day. There's a midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October when Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community at 19:45. On Saturday 10 October, several key matchups unfold: Allscott Heath (on a three-game winning run) host Brereton Social; Bilston Town welcome Crewe; Stafford Town face Wednesfield Community; Barnton host Dawley Town; Telford Town travel to New Mills; Market Drayton Town entertain Widnes Town; and Alsager Town visit Shawbury United (who are in freefall with six consecutive losses). Wolverhampton Casuals play at Wednesfield Community on Saturday 3 October. Brereton Social v Widnes Town, Cheadle Heath Nomads v Telford Town, Foley Meir v Bilston Town, and Shawbury United v Barnton complete the opening weekend fixture list.
